Sam (Sales): Quick sync — Aurelia Health wants a performance benchmark next Tue. Key asks: 95th tail <120ms for text-gen, ability to handle 500 qps bursts, and a security/keys writeup. Need runbook + cost sketch + answers for their security questionnaire. Who can own?
Maya (SE): I can run the bench. Need model choice + typical prompt/response sizes. Also: are they doing function calls / structured outputs?
Sam (Sales): They do chat-style medical summaries with function calls (structured JSON). Avg prompt ~1.8k tokens, expected response 200–350 tokens. They want 8k context support.
Ronnie (SRE): For a 500 qps burst we should plan reserved capacity or a Private deployment. If hosted: recommend Dedicated pool with pre-warmed nodes and multi-AZ routing. Also need a queueing buffer + backpressure to protect tail latency.
Priya (Security): Heads up — they require customer-managed keys (HSM) + audit logs and VPC peering. If they're sending unredacted PHI, Private deployment likely required. Can we confirm whether data can be pseudonymized?
Sam (Sales): They said pseudonymization is possible but slow. Initial ask: do a perf run with a subset of anonymized data while we work through the KM/HSM ask. Also need rough cost delta Dedicated vs Private.
Maya (SE): Run plan I propose:
- warmup 15m (gradual ramp)
- steady sweeps: 3x10m at 100/250/500 qps (collect p50/p90/p95/p99, GPU util, token/sec)
- 1h soak at expected average (100 qps)
- tail-latency histogram + per-token cost calc
I'll capture KV/prefix cache hit rates and set batch window to 10ms for the runs.
Ronnie (SRE): Ops checklist for the bench:
- pre-warm KV cache with typical prefixes
- set batch window 10ms, max batch size tuned by GPU model
- enable memory-friendly quantized variant if possible for throughput tests
- route traffic through dedicated pool in us-east-1, failover to us-west if capacity constrained
DeployBot: deploy-bot: initiating dedicated-bench infra in us-east-1 (cluster id: bench-1832).
Maya (SE): Quick k6 snippet for the steady-state load (you can drop into our CI):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({model: 'open-redwood-8k', input: '<<anonymized prompt>>', max_tokens: 300});
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', payload, {headers: {'Authorization':'Bearer $TOKEN','Content-Type':'application/json'}});
}
```
Sam (Sales): Nice. Priya — can you start the security answers? They sent a 40-question questionnaire; key open items are CMK/HSM, audit log retention (they want 7 years), and network isolation.
Priya (Security): I'll draft replies. Quick notes: Dedicated (hosted) supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations; HSM-backed CMKs can be done but requires contractual addendum. Audit logs: we can provide streaming to their SIEM or grant S3 export with retention policies; 7 years is supported with enterprise add-on. VPC peering for Dedicated is supported; Private covers all by default.
Sam (Sales): Pricing sketch request: can we get a rough monthly delta? They want to compare: Dedicated reserved (monthly commit) vs Private one-time infra + recurring ops.
Maya (SE): Ballpark numbers for sizing (based on 8k context, 250 token responses avg):
- Dedicated (4 x A100-class equivalent reserved pool): estimated sustained ~300 qps, burst to ~600 qps for short windows. Ballpark $45k–60k/month depending on network and storage.
- Private (initial infra + 24/7 ops + HSM): one-time infra ~ $250k–400k + recurring ~$90k/month ops/licenses. (Very rough; finance to confirm.)
Ronnie (SRE): Those numbers align with ops guidance. If they need guaranteed 500 qps sustained, we'd recommend Private or a larger Dedicated commit (6+ GPUs).
Sam (Sales): OK — plan: Maya to run the bench Tue 09:00 ET against anonymized dataset, Ron to stand by for infra tuning, Priya to send draft security answers today, and I'll share cost sketch with the customer after finance confirms.
Maya (SE): I'll attach the runbook & k6 scripts to the deal notes after the bench. Running smoke now to validate harness.
Priya (Security): Draft complete, uploading to the shared drive and starting the CMK/HSM legal checklist.
Sam (Sales): Thanks team — I'll update Aurelia and slot the 9am run. :thumbsup:
Ronnie (SRE): 👍 I'll monitor GPU temps and tail-latency feeds during the run.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: bench-1832 cluster up (3/3 nodes ready).
Maya (SE): All set on our side. Will post results + CSVs within 2 hours of run completion.
Sam (Sales): Perfect — closing this loop now.
